summary: Only one Drive Folder Sync now runs for each Windows user, even across Windows sessions and different ways of starting it.
The installer stops before changing files if Drive Folder Sync is still running; after this update, the app also checks for another copy before starting future updates.

The status bar now shows just the monitoring state and files pending sync, with one startup-check summary in Activity; protected activation, Google credentials, mappings, and established sync behavior are preserved.
